AMiner token not configured. Used WebSearch + domain knowledge to identify candidate missing baselines. Current 11 methods cover: (1) Classical inference-only: AdaIN, (2) Diffusion inference-only: SDEdit (4 strengths), SD-Turbo, StyleID, (3) GAN training-required: CUT, (4) Mamba training-required: SaMam, SaMST, (5) Identity baseline. Missing candidates: (A) Gatys' NST - foundational optimization-based (CVPR 2016); (B) WCT - whitening/coloring transform inference-only (CVPR 2017); (C) DreamStyler - diffusion style inversion (AAAI 2024); (D) InST - inversion-based style transfer (SIGGRAPH 2023); (E) StyleAligned - training-free diffusion (NeurIPS 2023); (F) StyTr2 - transformer-based (AAAI 2022); (G) ArtFlow - invertible flow (CVPR 2021); (H) CycleGAN - paired predecessor of CUT (ICCV 2017). Recommendation: Top priority is WCT (standard inference-only companion to AdaIN) and DreamStyler (recent AAAI 2024 diffusion baseline). Lower priority: Gatys NST (slow optimization), InST, StyleAligned.

WCT with VGG-normalised encoder (256-ch relu4_1) + AdaIN decoder FAILED. All 750 output PNGs had identical MD5 hash. Root cause: VGG-normalised encoder features have very narrow value range (mean~0.006, std~0.008) and nearly identical statistics across all 5 art styles. AdaIN decoder cannot decode WCT-transformed features (output range 0.0143-0.0253, 8-bit PNG quantization collapses all values to 3-6). adain_post normalization did NOT fix this because style feature statistics are nearly identical to content features. This is a theoretical limitation: AdaIN-trained decoder expects features with specific spatial structure, not just matching statistics.

WCT (Li et al. CVPR 2017) with VGG-19 ImageNet encoder (512-ch relu4_1) + AdaIN-trained VGG-19 decoder. adain_post=True mode. Inference-only, no training required. VGG-19 encoder features have wide value range (0-60) with distinct per-style statistics (mean 0.22-0.75, std 0.61-2.12). Decoder output range normal (-0.96 to 1.30), producing 750 unique images. Result: CLIP-S=0.7063 (delta_idt=+0.0664 > identity), LPIPS=0.6348. Better than AdaIN (0.6679/0.7425) but worse than CUT (0.7137/0.3743). WCT matches full covariance (vs AdaIN's mean/std only), achieving higher style transfer than AdaIN but with more content distortion. Position: mid-tier inference-only method.
